hooks.command: FILE="${TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-$TOOL_INPUT_file_path}"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.md ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *.rs ]]; then cargo run -- impact "$FILE" --format json 2>/dev/null; fi
if [[ "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.rs ]] || [[ "$TOOL_INPUT_file_path" == *.rs ]]; then cargo fmt --quiet 2>/dev/null || true; fi
FILE="${TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-$TOOL_INPUT_file_path}"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.md ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *.toml ]]; then dprint fmt "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
